missionPremise: P4 names two quarantines before Wave R: 188,103 placeholder setback-rule atoms citing storage-port-proof/phase-1a, and McLennan 65,814 envelopes derived from zero setback rules. Both are a value on the wire whose input does not exist. The Bastrop bake and the placeholder quarantine address the same rows by primary key (propertyEntityId version-1 is bare parcelNodeId; writePropertyAtom upserts ON CONFLICT atom_did DO UPDATE body). A quarantine that throws on the first placeholder parcel refuses the entire Bastrop city plan. Both published premises come from measure-setback-provenance.mjs, which reads fieldProvenance.front ONLY and assumes a FIPS-prefixed entity_id that assertCanonicalParcelEntityId does not enforce. 188,103 is a floor, not a count. McLennan zero may be a range-predicate artefact. Sources: _dispatches/2026-08-31_p4-quarantine_dispatch.md; _decisions/2026-08-31_bastrop_setbacks_bake_ruling.md; write-path read of measure-setback-provenance.mjs, setback-provenance-disposition.ts, plan-city-setback.ts refuseSetbackQuarantines, parcel-write-identity.ts:67, pg-storage writePropertyAtom, 2026-08-31T19:12Z.

File-based self-test fails on a fixture stamped with the placeholder DID (including side-only and rear-only) and passes on a known layer-23 Bastrop fixture. Detector for citing setback-rule rows of storage-port-proof/phase-1a exists, self-tests both directions, is CI-wired; does not fire on the code-section proof atom (Gate A / retrieval-api DEPLOY.md step 2). Mechanisms A-F evaluated from the write path; A recommended unless evidence says otherwise; B and C and D rejected with write-path reasons. plan-city-setback: incoming named source supersedes placeholder; one placeholder parcel does not refuse the city plan; collision is recorded on the parcel and the plan continues. Descriptor-fixture scope called, not silently widened or excluded. Consumer map verified at this snapshot; vendor-drift reported; atom-chain-to-facets commit named. MCP ICC meter impact named and requested, not edited. F1-F4 unrun until authorized; close status partial. Diff in the registered worktree. Planner commits.

instrumentRepair.what: Export classifySetbackProvenanceFromBody and the placeholder-axis predicate from measure-setback-provenance.mjs. CASE WHEN reads sourceCodeAtomRef.atomDid OR fieldProvenance.front.atomDid OR fieldProvenance.side.atomDid OR fieldProvenance.rear.atomDid. McLennan emits labeled predicates: entity_id FIPS range (existing), atom_did prefix did:hauska:setback-rule:48309:, jurisdiction_tenant if stamped; F4 PK resolve stays held and is not absorbed into a better range query. File-based self-test: side-only placeholder and rear-only placeholder classify placeholder; layer-23 Bastrop fixture classifies layer-23; a non-FIPS entity_id is invisible to the range predicate (proves the range is narrower than McLennan).

mechanismRecommendation.adopt: A — serve-time body predicate (classifySetbackRuleAtom already reads front/side/rear; applySetbackProvenanceServe on getPropertyAtomChain and assembleChain). No schema change, no mutation, no unwind: when Bastrop bake replaces the body on the same atom_did, the next read returns value.
mechanismRecommendation.rejectB: access_policy — resolveAccessPolicyOrRefuse refuses only null/empty; invented quarantined would write and then accessPolicyMatchesFilter would hide the atom on every surface, collapsing unknown into absent; collides with 2026-08-28 access-pair ruling
mechanismRecommendation.rejectC: status=retired — no status column on atoms; body.status retired means superseded and is not served; turns unknown into absence on 188103 parcels and rewrites content_hash/cid
mechanismRecommendation.rejectD: delete — forbidden on F-11; converts a wrong value into an absence
mechanismRecommendation.eRequirement: if a stored mark is used at all it must record the content_hash it was made against and invalidate when the body hash changes
mechanismRecommendation.fNote: Factory hold is not armed for setback/envelope rails; planWork iterates only cad/geometry/flood. Arming belongs to the Factory seat, not this one.

bastropPlanGranularity.what: refuseSetbackQuarantines stops throwing PLACEHOLDER_COLLISION. A parcel whose existing rule classifies unknown and whose incoming plan is present with binding.namedSource plans as present and records superseded-by-named-source on that row. A parcel whose existing rule classifies unknown and which has no named incoming source is recorded as placeholder-collision on that row and is not adopted as present; the rest of the city continues. McLennan envelope collision stays a named refuse until F4.
bastropPlanGranularity.falsifier: a city plan with one placeholder parcel and one clean parcel that throws. OR a placeholder parcel with a named incoming source that refuses PLACEHOLDER_COLLISION instead of planning present. OR F3: after overwrite, classifier still unknown.
bastropPlanGranularity.rejectedAlternative: per-parcel record-and-skip without supersede — that would still block baking the Bastrop in-city parcel that holds the placeholder, which is the same primary key the bake lands on
